title: History of AI: From Attention Is All You Need to the 2026 Slowdown Debate
usage: Data for webpage. Load year files 2017.json ... 2026.json. Each file has year, range, description, count, events[]. Each event has id, highlight, date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, category, organizations[], summary, significance, tags[]. Sort events by date for timeline. See note_on_slowdown_pact in 2026.json — there is NO binding lab pact as of 2026-09-30. Coverage researched through Oct 8; latest added event date is Oct 7. The Sep 29 White House safety accord is signed and voluntary, not a binding slowdown pact; Gemini 4 Argon remains a restricted preview. Selected additions include Grok 4.7, Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL, AMD's World Labs acquisition agreement and Meta Muse Gadgets. October 8 review applied 18 selected events, including 8 user-selected highlights. Pending access, previews and research limitations remain qualified; the two date-held candidates were excluded.

event.highlight: boolean; true when included in the curated Highlights view
event.title: string
event.category: paper | model-release | product | company | policy | drama | advance | infrastructure

disclaimer: Dates are best-available publication/announcement dates; some 2025-2026 rolling launches differ by surface (livestream vs blog vs GA). 2026 slowdown items labeled with confidence where single-sourced. Verify before presenting as pact.
